An '''experimental battle droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model built on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]].

==History==
This model was built in a [[Abandoned droid factory|droid factory]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Following the factory's abandonment, rogue [[Droid/Legends|droids]] wandered the deserts of [[Annamar]], constituting a threat to anyone on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Luca/Legends|Luca]] encountered such a droid, which hid underneath the sand, waiting for its prey. They managed to destroy the droid, but rested in a cave for the night, to avoid encountering more in the darkness.
